name: Converse with the hub in a plain terminal
principle: A person can converse with the hub in a plain terminal and always see what it is doing and what it asks.
state_description: Each line a person types is answered, the work behind each answer can be seen on request, every question the hub asks is shown where the person will see it and answered by the next line, and the session ends when the person leaves.
hints_of_measurement: Scripted sessions: every turn is answered, every question is answered, the session ends cleanly.

name: Work with the AI while it works
principle: A person can watch, stop, resume, steer and approve the AI while it works, and understand what it did, on any surface and with any harness.
state_description: Each step and helper appears as it happens with its target; Escape stops at once and keeps the work; resume continues without repeating; a correction shows as sent and then taken up; a risky step shows what will change and waits; the result lists the files changed, the cost and time, and the metric before and after; the same screen appears whichever harness runs.
hints_of_measurement: Scripted sessions on two harnesses: stop then resume loses nothing, a steer is taken up, helpers show with their parent, a risky step waits, the same script passes on both.
